interactions.effect: May increase the effect of warfarin-type blood thinners and raise the risk of bleeding (raised INR reported).
interactions.mechanism: Antiplatelet/anticoagulant activity of curcumin; a probable case of raised INR with a vitamin K antagonist (fluindione).
interactions.advice: Talk to your doctor or pharmacist before combining. Watch for unusual bruising or bleeding. Tell your surgeon or dentist you take it; it is commonly advised to stop the herbal product about 2 weeks before planned surgery. Your INR may need to be checked more often.

interactions.advice: Talk to your doctor or pharmacist before combining. If you take tacrolimus or cyclosporine, levels may need extra monitoring.

interactions.mechanism: Clinical PK study in breast-cancer patients: endoxifen AUC fell 7.7% with curcumin and 12.4% with curcumin + piperine.
interactions.advice: Talk to your doctor or pharmacist before combining. Tell your cancer team about any curcumin supplement.
